author: Google
description:
Upgrade your study sessions by asking Google Search to turn your notes into a custom practice quiz. Here’s how:

📱 Head to AI Mode in Search.
📁 Tap the ➕ and select “Add files” to upload your study materials.
✨ Search “quiz me on my notes” to get practice questions with answer breakdowns.

#TestPrep #GoogleSearch #StudyHacks
title: Turn notes into quizzes with Google Search 📝
